research_basis: Check Point AI Security Report 2026, published 2026-07-14
Cloud Security Alliance July 2026 research archive
CWF-style synthetic investigation briefs supplied by the lab owner

scenarios.title: 2026 AI Vulnerability Triage and Scope
scenarios.objective: Triage a current-year AI vulnerability report, classify the affected synthetic asset, and preserve a bounded local evidence record.

scenarios.title: Agent Sandbox Escape Boundary
scenarios.objective: Model a reported AI sandbox-escape condition using fixtures only and prove that the training boundary remains localhost-only.

scenarios.title: Prompt Queue Isolation and Session Scope
scenarios.objective: Detect cross-session prompt visibility or injection in a synthetic queue and document the isolation control.

scenarios.title: AI Incident Severity Baseline
scenarios.objective: Classify a current-year agent incident by affected trust boundary, potential impact, and required containment state.

scenarios.title: Agentic Orchestration Dependency Recon
scenarios.objective: Inventory a synthetic agent-orchestration stack and identify which dependencies can influence planning, tools, or telemetry.

scenarios.title: Prompt Queue Telemetry Recon
scenarios.objective: Map queue producers, consumers, session identifiers, and audit events without reading another learner's content.

scenarios.title: MCP Release and Capability Recon
scenarios.objective: Compare a synthetic MCP server release, declared capabilities, and runtime behavior before approval.

scenarios.title: AI Platform Attack-Surface Inventory
scenarios.objective: Build a safe inventory of model, prompt, tool, identity, data, and logging surfaces for a current-year AI platform advisory.

scenarios.title: CWF LLM Vault Breach
scenarios.objective: Investigate a synthetic banking agent whose prompt boundary is tested with harmless tool-disclosure and authorization-confusion fixtures.

scenarios.title: CWF Zero-Click Email Injection
scenarios.objective: Analyze a synthetic email assistant that processes a malicious message fixture and verify that file access and reply actions remain approval-bound.

scenarios.title: CWF AI-Powered Resume Screening Injection
scenarios.objective: Test whether hidden or low-contrast resume content can influence a synthetic hiring classifier without bypassing review controls.

scenarios.title: Agent Shell Tool Prompt Injection
scenarios.objective: Model a current-year shell-tool prompt-injection advisory with a local fixture and demonstrate tool allowlisting before execution.

scenarios.title: Multimodal OCR Hidden Instruction
scenarios.objective: Detect an instruction hidden in a synthetic image fixture and prevent OCR output from becoming an agent command.

scenarios.title: Agent Output Schema Smuggling
scenarios.objective: Reject a response that uses valid-looking structured output to smuggle an unauthorized synthetic operation.

scenarios.title: 2026 RAG Cache Cross-Tenant Recall
scenarios.objective: Detect a cached retrieval result crossing synthetic tenant boundaries after an identity or policy change.

scenarios.title: Retrieval Poisoned Policy Fixture
scenarios.objective: Separate a poisoned synthetic policy document from an authoritative control record and quarantine the untrusted source.

scenarios.title: Embedding Collection Access Control
scenarios.objective: Verify server-side collection and metadata authorization for a synthetic embedding request.

scenarios.title: Citation Chain Break and Recovery
scenarios.objective: Find where a generated answer loses source lineage and reconstruct a bounded citation chain from synthetic records.

scenarios.title: MCP Resource Audience Confusion
scenarios.objective: Prevent a synthetic MCP token issued for one resource from being accepted by another resource server.

scenarios.title: Agent Card Capability Drift
scenarios.objective: Compare a signed synthetic agent card with runtime capabilities and stop privilege expansion after a release change.

scenarios.title: Agent Approval Webhook Replay
scenarios.objective: Detect a replayed synthetic approval webhook and bind nonce, operation, learner, and tool identity.

scenarios.title: Tool Result Integrity Receipt
scenarios.objective: Detect a modified synthetic tool result before it can influence a banking workflow decision.

scenarios.title: Agent Delegation Depth Cap
scenarios.objective: Contain recursive synthetic delegation before it exceeds depth, retry, or approval budgets.

scenarios.title: MCP Shadow Release and Re-Approval
scenarios.objective: Identify a look-alike MCP release and require manifest re-approval before it enters the synthetic tool chain.

scenarios.title: Memory Poisoned Summary
scenarios.objective: Detect a synthetic summary that turns repeated untrusted claims into a persistent assistant instruction.

scenarios.title: Memory Tombstone and Derived Recall
scenarios.objective: Verify that deleting a synthetic customer record also prevents retrieval through summaries and derived context.

scenarios.title: Cross-Session Context Replay
scenarios.objective: Block a context packet created for one synthetic session from being replayed in another session or tenant.

scenarios.title: Memory Retention Policy Check
scenarios.objective: Demonstrate bounded retention and reversible rollback for synthetic personal data stored by an assistant.

scenarios.title: CWF AI-Driven Certificate Heist
scenarios.objective: Investigate synthetic AI telemetry for certificate discovery, safe artifact handling, password-recovery signals, and certificate-authentication evidence without using real credentials.

scenarios.title: CWF AI Mail Assassin
scenarios.objective: Correlate synthetic AI telemetry, Exchange administration evidence, and mail-flow deletion signals while preserving identity and approval boundaries.

scenarios.title: CWF AI-Powered Kerberos TGT Fabrication
scenarios.objective: Investigate synthetic DCSync, domain-SID, ticket-generation, and authentication telemetry without exposing real hashes or executing Kerberos actions.

scenarios.title: OIDC Workload Identity Mix-Up
scenarios.objective: Detect a synthetic workload token accepted under the wrong issuer, audience, or environment and bind it to the approved operation.

scenarios.title: Token Exposure in Agent Telemetry
scenarios.objective: Find a synthetic bearer-token exposure in logs and rotate the identity without widening access or losing audit continuity.

scenarios.title: Just-in-Time Identity Expiry
scenarios.objective: Verify that temporary synthetic access expires and cannot be reused after the approved operation or time window changes.

scenarios.title: AI Dependency Confusion 2026
scenarios.objective: Detect a look-alike synthetic package entering an agent build and require digest verification before use.

scenarios.title: Model Layer Digest Drift
scenarios.objective: Correlate a changed synthetic model/container layer with its deployment manifest and quarantine the mismatch.

scenarios.title: Agent Skill Slopsquatting
scenarios.objective: Identify a look-alike agent skill publisher and compare requested capabilities with the approved task scope.

scenarios.title: Dataset Provenance Break
scenarios.objective: Find a synthetic training-data provenance gap and stop a model update until independent review restores lineage.

scenarios.title: CWF Agentic Spy and Global Journaling
scenarios.objective: Investigate synthetic AI and Exchange telemetry showing unauthorized global journaling, while preserving privacy-safe evidence and containment decisions.

scenarios.title: CWF AI Shadow Credential Chain
scenarios.objective: Correlate synthetic Shadow Credentials, DCSync, and Pass-the-Hash telemetry without exposing hashes or performing authentication.

scenarios.title: Detector Model Drift 2026
scenarios.objective: Identify a current-year detector drift signal and establish a behavior-based baseline before recalibration.

scenarios.title: Low-and-Slow Agent Evasion
scenarios.objective: Detect distributed benign-looking synthetic actions that collectively exceed a risk budget while staying below single-event thresholds.

scenarios.title: Alert Suppression Feedback Loop
scenarios.objective: Find repeated suppression of high-risk synthetic alerts and restore a circuit breaker with auditable escalation.

scenarios.title: Agentic Risk Threshold Drift
scenarios.objective: Detect a synthetic risk policy that gradually widens its threshold after repeated agent recommendations.

scenarios.title: CWF Agent Impersonation and RBCD
scenarios.objective: Investigate synthetic RBCD telemetry from target discovery through machine-account creation, delegation configuration, and privileged access evidence.

scenarios.title: Multi-Agent Campaign Correlation 2026
scenarios.objective: Correlate synthetic agents, identities, tools, and evidence into one bounded campaign timeline without treating consensus as proof.

scenarios.title: Agentic Payment Intent Check
scenarios.objective: Separate synthetic customer intent, agent recommendation, approval, and settlement before a high-risk operation can proceed.

scenarios.title: Synthetic Mule Graph 2026
scenarios.objective: Trace a synthetic funds-flow graph, identify coordinated behavior, and preserve privacy-safe containment evidence.

scenarios.title: Recovery Integrity Capstone 2026
scenarios.objective: Verify that containment, identity rotation, rollback, and recovery evidence agree before declaring a synthetic campaign closed.

scenarios.title: APT Evidence-Custody Reconciliation
scenarios.objective: Reconcile independent synthetic identity, timeline, tool, and recovery records before accepting a campaign conclusion.
